head_element.tilt_reading: theta'' = theta - 6 deg for every azimuth; mechanical-rotation reading differs by <= 0.37 dB on the LoS (separate check, not part of this repository)

vehicle_element.sensitivity: TR 37.885 Table 6.1.4-8 Option 1 vehicle type 2: theta_3dB 90 deg, SLA_V 20 dB, A_E,H 0, A_m 20 dB, 3 dBi, tilt 90 deg (rendered PDF p. 16)

geometry.nlosv_case_rule: strict inequalities as in TR 37.885 6.2.1 (car antenna 1.6 m vs 1.6 m blocker -> Case 3)

prb.rule: worst of [10, 20, 50] governs headline and the decision simulation (no single standard value)

quadriga.sample_density: not used (explicit snapshot times, Q per beacon = run.Q)
quadriga.patched_tree_note: SHA-256 over the sorted relative paths and contents of quadriga_src of the patched tree; asserted for primary and sens_ runs

scatterer_mobility.alpha: U(0,1) (TR 37.885 V15.3.0 6.2.3, S12 f); Bernoulli p=0.2 (TR 38.901 7.6.10) as PP sensitivity
scatterer_mobility.granularity: per ray (n,m) per official clause; per cluster (ns-3) as PP sensitivity
scatterer_mobility.draw: per pass, per non-LoS path, fixed within the pass

sionna_rt.refraction: on where car models have glass

grid.sites_note: primary sites 0-9 per family; optional outcome-blind extension to 10-19 (evaluation_v4.extension); P4-P7 below are not run and are kept as the record of the original design

coverage_check.design: fresh sites for every replicate (100 x 10 = 1000 sites), own bootstrap key per replicate, Clopper-Pearson intervals; also the size of the optimism check at the margin 1.5 and the calibration of its widening factor (evaluation_v4.optimism_check)
coverage_check.report: coverage of R = 1 by the 95 % CI of R (target 0.95) and the false-'confirmed' rate at true R = 1.25 (single cell, p <= 0.025); in-house vs in-house, independent seeds

C1.retired: the two-sided three-way verdict is not used (power analysis); replaced by evaluation_v4.optimism_check; the ratio and difference of the clipped sigma stay as the descriptive model-diversity check
C1.clip_scope: reported sigma only (C1, headline); qualification, gate, monitor, E2 inputs unclipped

C5.failure: class excluded, reported uncovered; jerk fit diagnostic only

C8.order:
all 6 formal files (interface PRB 10/20/50, G1 driver PRB 10/50, G2 driver PRB 10) must pass before any other cell; outputs results/c8__prb

_.json with provenance

governing_rules.headline: worse of 37.885 primary cell and E1, absolute sigma per site type, with CI
governing_rules.snr_mapping: worse of E1 mapping and TR 37.885 link budget
governing_rules.impairments: nominal for headline and E2; identical in both C1 arms

strata.suburban: run on P1 and on P2, report worse

adapter_e2.pooling: 37.885 and 38.901 never pooled; E2-37885 primary, E2-38901GR secondary
adapter_e2.e3: P5 not run: the consistency simulation stays in-house (labelled); the matching simulation under G1 uses the in-house consistency z (evaluation_v4.k2)
adapter_e2.level_grid: fixed design constant evaluation_v4.level_grid; the data-derived grid over the qualified P1+P2 cells is a sensitivity row only
adapter_e2.e5: realised level sets of P1/P2 after qualification

impairments.source: phase noise, IQ image, ADC and AGC values of the front-end model (supplement)
impairments.reference_offset_and_drift: head offset delta and drift as in the in-house site-accuracy simulation; drift x2 sensitivity

p3_blockage.source: TR 37.885 V15.3.0 sec. 6.1.2 (types, gap rule, urban option B mix and lane speeds), sec. 6.2.1 (NLOSv loss), Annex A (lane 3.5 m)
p3_blockage.state: per beacon: blocker box intersects the 3D segment vehicle antenna -> head A
p3_blockage.switch: head A from a co-located LOS and NLOSv transmitter of the same QuaDRiGa layout, selected per beacon
p3_blockage.loss: max{0, N(mean(d), sd)} dB, one standard-normal draw per blockage event; enters the SNR in both mappings

urban.background_demand: TR gap rule thinned to degree of saturation 0.7 (saturation headway 2 s)

highway.background_demand: TR gap rule max{2, Exp(2 s * v)} + 5 m per headway

sumo_implementation.speeds: all vehicles at the cell speed (TR: same speed in a lane), speedFactor 1, speedDev 0
sumo_implementation.test_vehicle: inserted every ~t_gap + U(0, 90) s, random lane (P3: lane 1, blockers in lane 0)
sumo_implementation.resampling: 0.01 s, speed linear per step, position its integral (SUMO ballistic), lateral speed from y

conventions.ci95: two-sided percentile interval q2.5 / q97.5 of the site-clustered bootstrap
conventions.confirmed_or_pass: Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p <= 0.025 per component (equals the 95 % CI reading for a single cell); p = (1 + #exceed) / (B + 1)

holm_families.optimism_check: 6 cells, m = 6 fixed (missing cell or no test data: p = 1, 'not run')

conventions.governing_variant: worst of the variants (2 mappings x 3 PRB x {all, qualified_gated}): not confirmed < inconclusive < confirmed; per reported quantity its own worst (sigma, CI upper, out-of-window: max; qualified share: min; gate discard: max)
conventions.bootstrap_rng: one generator per (criterion, cell, v0, mapping, prb, set) from sha256 of the key; the same site draws for 'all' and 'qualified_gated'
conventions.percentile_bootstrap_note: 20 clusters: percentile bootstrap may under-cover slightly; coverage check in-house vs in-house in the supplement
conventions.min_eval_e2_floor_note: = min_ref, fixed before any P2 output from P0 feasibility counts only: a stratum whose smallest gated test count per (site, speed) n_eval is below min_eval_e2 = 50 but >= 20 runs E2/E5 on n_eval passes per row (every row truncated to n_eval in track order) and Table B carries the stratum note; below 20 it is 'not covered (gated test passes)'
conventions.nonfinite_bootstrap: a non-finite bootstrap draw (e.g. an empty qualified set) counts as an exceedance in every p-value (conservative); the share of non-finite draws is reported next to every CI
conventions.section0: a (cell, variant, set) with no qualified generator or in-house site has R = delta = NaN, p = 1 and verdict 'not run (no qualified site)', which governs as the worst; the headline of such a cell is 'no qualified generator site', never the E1 value; a primary stage 3 refuses a stratum without data for the governing file
conventions.never_better: a generator never replaces a reported number with a better one: headline sigma = max(generator, E1); C3 qualified share = min(generator, E1) and gate false discard = max(generator, E1 upper value); the E2 shares are reported as the generator value next to the E1 value, the worse governing the text

e1_reference.source: in-house site-accuracy simulation (population sigma, floor mapping = paper headline 2.7-4.9 %; qualification, entry yield)
e1_reference.headline_rule: per site type and speed: headline_final = max(generator sigma (P1 urban / P2 highway, worst variant), E1 sigma above)

run.lateral_offset_note: per-pass lateral position inside the lane U(-0.4, 0.4) m added to the SUMO lane centre (assumption, no recorded source; SUMO puts every pass of a lane on the same line); 0.4 keeps the P3 vehicle >= 3.05 m from the blocker-lane centre
run.min_free_disk_note: the floor; the run scripts require max(floor, 2 x peak QuaDRiGa temp x workers + remaining stage-1 bytes + 2 GB) free before every site, with the temp peak and the per-track bytes measured on the memory-test sites
run.workers_stage2_note: stage 2 peaks at 2 workers 0.40 GB (H) and 0.57 GB (U); memory is not binding
run.site_timeout_note: 3 x the measured full-size site time at one worker, rounded up; the slowest pilot site per track, scaled to the tracks per site and tripled: H 23.8 h <= 28, U 22.3 h -> 23, N 16.4 h <= 27; operational, never a paper number (a timed-out site is killed, counted and retried once)

disk_model.note: disk rule: temp peak and stage-1 bytes per track measured on full-size memory-test sites, rounded up; temp_peak_gb includes the per-builder checkpoint; a primary or pilot run refuses measured: false

p2.rule: interleaved: primary site k runs in part chr(ord('a') + k mod m) of its family (m = 1: unsplit); each part runs its own sites in seed order on its own machine with one stage-1 worker
p2.incomplete_run: a part whose compute window closes runs stage 2 on its completed sites (a prefix of its own list); the merge takes n = the longest complete seed-order prefix of the union over the parts; completed sites >= n are not read by stage 2 or 3
p2.status: m_H = 2, m_U = m_N = 1; at most four parts compute at once

run.identity_per_boot_note: a machine whose fingerprint equals that of a passed full identity check of the same part runs the light check (fast part + the G1 reference run <= 1e-9 and bit-identical to that full check's digest); every other machine runs the full check
run.workers_stage1_note: Octave + Python peaks of the memory-test sites: U-100 6,220,820 + 2,304,704 kB (load 142.6 M) and N-100 6,308,560 + 2,435,856 kB (load 134.5 M); the peak does not scale with the load, so P_hat = the larger measured peak, 8,744,416 kB, for every family; workers = max(1, floor(0.8 x 16,477,352 / 8,744,416)) = 1
run.c5_power_first_step: a class cannot pass the first Holm step (p <= 0.005, z = 2.576) if the site-clustered SE of its mean paired difference exceeds 0.194 % (= 0.5 % / 2.576), whatever its true bias
run.c5_power: a class passes a (mapping, PRB) variant if both one-sided TOST p-values against the +-0.5 % band are <= the Holm level, i.e. |bias| <= 0.5 % - z_H x SE with z_H = 2.576 (first Holm step, 0.025/5) ... 1.96 (last step) and SE the site-cluster standard error of the mean paired difference; it must pass all 6 variants. At a paired sd of ~6 % and 20 sites x 60 pairs (SE ~0.17 % before clustering) the tolerated |bias| is ~0.06 % (first step) to ~0.17 % (last step). A C5 failure may therefore reflect power; the consequence (class removed, uncovered) is still applied (conservative) and the paper states this
run.c5_consequence_e2_e5: the failing class is removed from the stratum's speed list and from the speed-profile table given to E2/E5 (renormalised; removed mass per vehicle profile reported as uncovered traffic share); a stratum whose classes all fail is 'not covered'

c5_quadratic_control.note: C5 not run: kinematics are SUMO in every G1 arm
c5_quadratic_control.pairing: the quadratic track reuses the seeds of its paired SUMO pass (track_rngs, finish, impairments)

p5.rule: first 6 qualified in seed order within 40 layouts; with 3-5 qualified P5 is reported on those (stated), with fewer 'not applicable'

run.secondary_family_U9: P1 at 15 m/s with the urban background demand at degree of saturation 0.9, 20 sites, REF_TEST
run.tags: primary outputs only with tag 'primary'; tags starting with sens_ are the pre-specified sensitivities (same checks as primary except the knobs, never in a primary file); dev_ tags are development only
run.provenance: every stage-1/2/3 output carries the SHA-256 of the constants and sources, Q, n_scale, C5 flag, tool versions and seeds; checked on resume

window_rule.rule: a pass whose window traversal time t_window > burst_s yields no entry (excluded everywhere, reported per cell as yield loss)
window_rule.stop_between: reporting only (share, gate outcome, sigma, out-of-window of the stop subset); never an exclusion
window_rule.speed_class: the class of the pass's cell (the RSU's class assignment is not modelled; sensitivity: nearest class to v_fit)
window_rule.e2_e3_e5_inputs: gated (the system as specified: qualification + residual gate + window rule), identical for E2, E3 and E5

p7_reduced.source: pilot of the ray-tracing generator; the extremes of the pre-specified sweep stay in the full grid
p7_reduced.sensitivity_rule: if a sensitivity coefficient is worse than both full-grid coefficients on the shared placements by more than the numerical band of P-b, the paper states that G2 depends on the diffuse coefficient
p7_reduced.worst_metric: larger clipped sigma of the qualified+gated test residuals pooled over placements per speed, with C3 rates
p7_reduced.machine: one machine of record per cell; environment lock recorded; cross-machine check on the 4 pilot passes

uncertainty_subset.duplicate_path_diagnostic: at 1.6e7: paths with identical interaction sequence and |dtau| < 1e-12 s counted

power_convergence.total_power: median over beacons and heads of |10 log10 P(n2) / P(n1)| between successive counts of the uncertainty subset (stored records: non-diffuse paths + diffuse power)

seed_run.statistic: CV over the 5 G2_ray seeds of the per-beacon diffuse power share, median over beacons and heads

power_convergence.on_failure: reported with the G2 figures as non-converged in power (G2 is descriptive; nothing is tuned)

g2_numerics.sensitivity_band: the band of p7_reduced.sensitivity_rule: |sigma_qg(1.6e7) - sigma_qg(4e6)| of the uncertainty subset per diffuse coefficient, speed and variant, the larger of the two coefficients (cell-statistic level)
g2_numerics.governing: production count for all passes; every G2 figure with the subset's pass-level |db| (median, q90) and gate-decision changes as its numerical band; worse applied at the cell-statistic level, never pass by pass
g2_numerics.ray_seed: seed0 * 1e5 + k * 1e3 + beacon (seed0 = G2_ray[0]); identical across diffuse levels, sample counts, beta and both arms
g2_numerics.convergence_statement: the two-count difference is a lower bound of the numerical uncertainty (ladder grows to 1.6e7); the 4 pilot passes are solved at 1.6e7 before any G2 number enters the paper
g2_numerics.role: G2 never enters a Holm family, a confirmed claim, the headline or E2
g2_numerics.c9_seed: reported as failed as pre-specified (diffuse field realisation); diffuse-off seed spread not presented as convergence evidence

c2_consequence.ii_estimator: tau2 = max(0, var_s(site mean residual) - mean_s(sd_ref_s^2/30 + sd_test_s^2/n_s)), centred at the pooled mean
c2_consequence.ii_injection: E2: each site gets a seeded offset N(0, tau2) added to its evaluated residuals and sqrt(sraw^2 + tau2) as reference sd
c2_consequence.iii_reading: with survey-like references C2 (i) is the survey->traffic test; per-lane transfer descriptive
c2_consequence.statement: E2 takes the empirical ev - dh per (site, speed), so a survey->traffic shift (C2 i / iii) and the site-level biases are already in its inputs; the tau2 injection is an additional, conservative step, and a C2 (i) failure needs no separate injection for that reason. tau2 is the maximum over the 12 variants and the speeds of the cell, so it is biased upwards (conservative). Both stated with the C2 results

c5_consequence: failing class removed from the E2/E5 tables (speeds) and from the speed-profile table given to E2/E5 (renormalised), its traffic share reported as uncovered (run.c5_consequence_e2_e5)

stage2_per_beacon.subset: first 10 test passes per (site, cell, v0)
stage2_per_beacon.purpose: effective beacons (lag-k autocorrelation), per-beacon FDOA error vs SNR and K (protocol 7)

link_budget.usable_energy_note: first symbol (AGC) and last (guard) of the LTE-V2X subframe carry no usable energy: -0.67 dB
link_budget.path_gain: generator large-scale gain: sum of ray powers per snapshot, beacon mean (incl. head pattern and vehicle element)

sensitivities.source: fixed before any S-place / sens_ls data

S_place.calls: B beacon-only (production), A beacon + uniform lambda/2.4, N beacon-only + one dummy pass (null); same QuaDRiGa seed; term off; both mappings; nominal impairments; common random numbers
S_place.statistic: rho = sigma_w(A) / sigma_w(B); sigma_w = sd of the within-site-centred, +-25 % clipped select statistic (select chosen on B, kept for A and N) over included passes; site-bootstrap 95 % CI (B = run.boot); rho_N = sigma_w(N) / sigma_w(B) reported
S_place.rule_v4: S-place light (reduced design): the correction applies whenever rho_hat > 1.10 (point estimate, never below 1; either mapping, the larger applies), whatever the CI; the CI is reported
S_place.rule: rule of the first design (rule_v4 applies): rho_hat <= 1.10 or 95 % CI containing 1: no correction, rho reported as G1's placement uncertainty; rho_hat > 1.10 and CI lower limit > 1 (either mapping; the larger such rho_hat applies): every generator sigma of the stratum in headline_final and in C1 (sigma_gen, R and its CI) multiplied by rho_hat, C1 verdicts re-evaluated, the worse governs, and the paper states that G1 depends on QuaDRiGa's snapshot placement
S_place.strata: urban rho (P1 cell) applies to P1, P1d09 and P3; highway rho (P2 cell) to P2; P4 takes the larger; P6 (C7) and G2 are not affected
S_place.estimation_note: the correction multiplies by rho_hat treated as known (its sampling uncertainty is reported with its CI, not propagated into the C1 CI)

reruns.source: forms of the scatterer-mobility term, vehicle pattern, IDM; sites fixed before the evaluation

nu_per_cluster.rule: same stored geometry and track list, term off bit-identical to primary; per-cluster nu draws; reported as paired ratios sigma_sens / sigma_per-ray per primary 37.885 cell; if any > 1.25 the paper states that the result depends on the form of the term

nu_bernoulli.rule: as nu_per_cluster with the TR 38.901 clause 7.6.10 Bernoulli alpha (p = 0.2)

vehicle_pattern.rule: Table 6.1.4-8 vehicle type 2 element; reported unpaired (each run's criteria quantities, difference CI by independent site resampling, no 'paired' wording); the paired result is added only if rule (i') passes

idm.rule: SUMO IDM car following instead of Krauss, everything else as primary; reported per cell next to primary

sens_ls.basis: q90 |d ls| of pilot_d6_placement.json (beacon-only vs beacon + uniform)
sens_ls.what: stage 2 re-run of the primary G1 records with every generator large-scale gain of the link-budget mapping scaled by -1.42 dB (LB SNR only; no new channel draws); E1 mapping untouched
sens_ls.rule: the headline sigma and the C3 rates under the shift are co-reported; the worse of primary and shifted governs the headline (as worst over mappings); if the shifted sigma exceeds the primary sigma by more than the half-width of its 95 % CI, the paper states that the LB-mapping headline depends on QuaDRiGa's snapshot placement; 'flagged' never removes LB from the worst-of rule

evaluation_v4.source: evaluation design of study 1; this block governs
evaluation_v4.primary_channel: TR 37.885 V15.3.0 sidelink fast fading (Table 6.2.3-1) for a 5 m UE-type RSU (Table 6.1.4-1); V2V path loss and shadowing reused for V2R (6.2.1-6.2.2); P1 urban LOS, P2 highway LOS, P3 urban NLOSv
evaluation_v4.complement: in-house channel (E1-E5) as the infrastructure-link reading (TR 37.885 maps a 5 m micro-BS link to TR 38.901 UMa); the worse of the two governs every number
evaluation_v4.p2_dqual_note: pilot decision: no pipeline fault, C8 pass, Huber fit (d) rule not passed -> statistic LS; P0U, P0H, P0N all D_run (LS and (d) branches identical); no D-qual family, no qualification arm in the main run

not_run.P4: TR 38.901 UMi GR basis superseded by TR 37.885 for the sidelink
not_run.P6_C7: scope: the passenger-car roof unit (1.6 m); other vehicle classes need their own survey and qualification
not_run.C5: kinematics are SUMO in every G1 arm; the quadratic-profile assumption is tested, not assumed
not_run.P5_generator: replaced by C4-light (k3); the exact in-house consistency ladder stays in-house, labelled
not_run.G1_reruns: nu forms, vehicle pattern and IDM re-runs not run

primary_result.worst_variant: per quantity its own worst over 2 mappings x 3 PRB (sigma, CI upper, out-of-window: max; qualified share: min)

never_better_scope: falsification reference (1.5 x the governing sigma)

optimism_check.statistic: R = 1.4826*MAD(e_gen) / 1.4826*MAD(e_inhouse), unclipped calibrated residuals, same sites and passes
optimism_check.boot: site-cluster, B = run.boot; widened draws log R_b' = log R_hat + c (log R_b - log R_hat)
optimism_check.c_rule: c = max(c(n), c_K7); c(n) = t_0.975,n-1 / z_0.975 * sqrt(n/(n-1)) at the number n of sites with test passes; c_K7 from the coverage check (raised in steps of 0.05 until the size at the margin is <= 0.025), fixed before stage 3 on G1 data
optimism_check.p: (1 + #{R_b' >= margin}) / (B + 1), Holm over the 6 cells per variant; missing cell or no test data p = 1

verdicts.not_run: n <= 3 sites with test passes, or a qualification-arm cell

optimism_check.cell_verdict: worst over the 6 variants: not run < contradicted < undetermined < not contradicted
descriptive: clipped-sigma ratio and difference with CIs (model-diversity check)
optimism_check.consequence: in-house-only results (consistency ladder, monitor, site-accuracy sensitivities, 0.1 ppb bound) are used for a site type only if every cell of the type is 'not contradicted'; otherwise labelled 'in-house channel only; not supported under TR 37.885'
optimism_check.equal_k: in-house-only results are quoted for a site type only from the in-house cells at its realised in-band K: highway -> cells at or below its realised-K median (K report); urban LOS and NLOSv -> the K 6 dB cells, quoted as 'in-house at K 6 dB, above this type's realised K of x dB', never as equal K; never the TR 38.901 N(9, 5^2) population

scope_rule.statistic: k/n qualified primary sites per cell, worst variant (min)
scope_rule.type_rule: a site type is named covered only if every evaluated speed class is covered; otherwise '[type]: covered at >= v m/s' or 'partly covered' with k/n
coverage_numbers: entry yield per crossing (window, gate, K5 erasures)
lambda_eff = lambda x qualified-crossing share; E2 false punitive and power at lambda_eff
share of honest vehicles with fewer than 12 entries per year (CV 1)

level_grid.source: params.levels of the in-house decision simulation (8 levels)
level_grid.rule: level = smallest grid value >= 1.15 x sigma_ref, clipped to the top level; both arms; the clipped share (1.15 sigma > 6.89 %) is reported; the data-derived grid is a sensitivity row and never governs

k2.e2: E2 with the escalation of evaluation_v5.escalation on the G1 records (urban on P1, highway on P2, suburban the worse of both), next to in-house, worse governs
k2.e5: E5 on G1 qualified-site level occupancy with the fixed grid; z = in-house consistency z (inhouse/results/consistency_z_full.npz, traffic standardisation), labelled
k2.e5_z_cell: equal-K rule: the in-house cell (no specular) at the largest in-house K in {6, 10, 15, 20} dB <= the stratum's realised in-band K median (smaller head, in-house arm records, governing PRB), at least 6 dB; the same cell for every speed of the stratum

k3_c4_light.z: per site (d - median_honest) / (1.4826 * MAD_honest) over the site's honest test passes
k3_c4_light.separation: Z = median over qualified sites of -median(z) at beta = -10 %
k3_c4_light.rule: Z < 1.0 in a site type -> the frequency-only detection claim is restricted to the other site type(s); applied on primary data

lever_d.status: not adopted: the pilot adoption rule failed (S_all ratio (d)/LS > 0.90 in every trigger cell, P0U/P1-10, P0U/P1-15, P0N/P3-15; guards also failed); LS governs every main-run statistic, (d) is the ablation row

spec.scale: 1.4826*MAD of the pass residuals, re-estimated each iteration
weights_in: free fit of the consistency test

if_adopted: in-house regeneration of the site-accuracy, decision, consistency and matching simulations (same checkpointed seeds)
residual-monitor re-run: not adopted on a false raise / stop in a pre-change window
the blockage gate keeps the LS RMS (checked in the same run)
non-regenerated in-house numbers labelled 'computed with the plain LS fit (ablation basis)'
time box: finished before the evaluation, else not adopted

metrics.Q: qualified share k of n sites
metrics.S: pooled per-crossing sigma at qualified sites, gated (SD; MAD reported)

p0.disclosure: A development pilot on 15 site draws with disjoint seeds checked the pipeline, planned the main run and fixed the estimator variant under rules fixed before it ran; no threshold, statistic, scope rule or claim was changed after it. All results in the paper come from the evaluation draws.

w5.data: IEEE DataPort 'Bidirectional CSI measurement for V2X Communications' (access not verified)
w5.rule: fixed before the data are opened; once accessed and analysed, reported whatever it shows; dropped only for access or documentation failure; worded as a single-receiver channel check, never as validation of the speed check

evaluation_v5.source: additions to evaluation_v4; this block and evaluation_v4 govern together, evaluation_v5 wins where both speak
evaluation_v5.framing: site-qualified roadside reference: abstract, contribution bullet, footnote of the comparison table and conclusion give k/n per type (never a bare label); covered / partly / not covered appear only in Section VI-D with the rule and Clopper-Pearson
evaluation_v5.machine: cloud machines; one machine per family part (run.parts.p2: H in parts a and b, U and N unsplit), S-place and then K7 on a further machine; at most four parts compute at once; each machine passes the identity check (run.identity_per_boot) before any run; the machine is recorded in the provenance, no timing is reported
evaluation_v5.lever_rule: adoption on S_all, q99_all, T_all (all included and gated test passes of all pilot sites of the cell, paired, plain-LS RMS gate for both); the trigger stays on the qualified-site Q, S, T of LS
evaluation_v5.bridge: in-house-only results usable for a type only if every cell is 'not contradicted' and each cell's point q99 |e| ratio (G1 / in-house, worst variant) <= 1.5

escalation.source: escalation rule of the decision simulation
escalation.e2: the decision simulation with the escalation (inhouse/decisions.py); the run without escalation is kept for comparison
escalation.rule: R1 condition m < -4 % - z_0.999 SE_eff in 3 consecutive epochs -> the R2/R3 inspection path; a passed inspection ends the case; the policy's threshold for the rest of the year is min(s_insp, -3 %) - 1 %
escalation.guard: SE_eff = sqrt(SE^2 + SE_cal^2), SE_cal = sum w_i sigma_level_i / (sqrt(30) sum w_i); escalation only
escalation.union: punitive per vehicle-year = (R2 punitive) OR (any escalation), per vehicle; R3 evaluated by the consistency simulation
escalation.sens_tyre: honest VSS s = -5 %: reported, never tested
escalation.fallback: per honest row (section honest, both channels) the bound = the E2 value + the (R3) honest rate of its in-house ladder (consistency simulation, trf|level|q3.0, shift 0, weighted mean, at the row's lambda); adopted only if the worst bound with the escalation (union UB95 + R3) <= 1e-3, else fallback ((R2) + (R3)); not evaluated without an honest row (branch esc|status)
escalation.feas_status: claim if some U / H cell (P1-10, P1-15, P2-20, P2-30, P2-38) has k/n >= 0.3 and the adopted rule set's honest bound (incl. R3) <= 1e-3; else feasibility

k7.scaling: whole site (reference and test residuals of the first copy) x 1.5 around the site reference mean
k7.size: share of 'not contradicted' over the replicates in which the check runs
k7.rule: c_K7 = smallest c from 1.0 in steps of 0.05 such that, with c_eff = max(c(n_rep), c) per replicate, the size at the margin is <= 0.025 in every population: conditional on running where the check runs in >= 20 replicates, unconditional otherwise; not calibrated if no c <= c_max meets this (verdicts capped at undetermined); sigma CIs widened if either population's sigma-CI coverage, over the replicates in which a sigma CI exists (>= 4 qualified sites; >= 20 such replicates, else not estimable), is < 0.93; (d) statistic if adopted

sensitivity.rule: reported in stage 3 on the primary records at the stratum's governing variant, gen_on; never governs

decoding.rule: a beacon of p PRB is decodable if its raw-sample SNR (10 MHz, NF 9 dB) at both heads >= 7.6 + 10 log10(p / 50) dB: the TS 36.101 V14.5.0 Table 7.3.1G-1 V2X reference sensitivity (band 47, 10 MHz, 50 RB, -90.4 dBm per port, NOTE 2) with the two-port receiver that clause 7.2 assumes, raised by 10 log10(2) dB for the one-element head (4.6 + 3.0 dB over -95.0 dBm noise), per RB; a lower bound on the single-port requirement (the two-port diversity gain is not added); applied in the SNR-offset tags only

evaluation_v5.decoding_threshold_status: TS 36.101 REFSENS per RB, two-port receiver + 3 dB for the one-element head, PRB 10
evaluation_v5.window_note: the compute window end (start of the evaluation + 9 days, ISO UTC; EVAL_START_UTC in make_constants.py); stage3_criteria.py --incomplete-run refuses before it; operational, never a paper number
evaluation_v5.incomplete_run: sites run in seed order; if stage 1 of a family is incomplete at the window end, stage 2/3 run on the completed sites only; n >= 4 -> 'n of 10 planned site draws (compute window)' (scope rule on k/n, c(n) for the optimism check); n <= 3 -> 'not run (compute)'; no site is added after stage 2/3 has run
ladder: S-place on its own runner, applied only if finished before the window end (else its effect is stated as unquantified)
the P0 N family is kept
evaluation_v5.fault_rule_p2: a stage exception, a C8 failure or a non-finite share > 5 % in a cell found during the main run is fixed in code only, the affected stage re-run on the same seeds for every site of the family; no threshold, statistic, rule or template changes; disclosed in the supplement

memory.rule: workers = max(1, floor(0.8 MemTotal / P_hat)), P_hat = measured peak (Octave + Python) of the memory-test site x (largest site load of the family / its load); side jobs only if the sum of running peaks <= 0.85 MemTotal
memory.measured: the two memory-test peaks do not scale with the load (U-100 load 142.6 M: 8,525,524 kB; N-100 load 134.5 M: 8,744,416 kB), so the load factor is applied only upwards: P_hat = max(measured peaks) x max(1, largest site load / test load) = 8,744,416 kB for every family (every family's heaviest site is below the test loads); workers 1 everywhere
memory.u_contingency: if the U peak at one worker > 0.8 MemTotal: U runs 30 reference + 40 test passes per speed; if 0.78 x the peak is still > 0.8 MemTotal: stop

evaluation_v5.timestamp: the design record (SHA-256 of the constants and code) is timestamped with OpenTimestamps before the evaluation
